EC1: Indication  for emergent cesarean [OR] or known fetal anomaly
EC2: Anti-hypertensive therapy received in the past 12 hours
EC3: History of eclampsia [OR] or other adverse CNS complication (e.g., stroke [OR] or PRES) in this pregnancy
EC4: Actively wheezing  at time of enrollment [OR] or history of asthma complications
